map.平均寿命计算器求放射性核素在指数衰变下的平均存活时间 τ=1/λ，适合核物理、放: The mean life calculator gives the average survival time tau = 1/lambda of a radionuclide under exponential decay, for describing decay characteristics in nuclear physics, radiochemistry and tracer experiments.
map.放射性核素的平均存活时间。: The average survival time of a radionuclide.
map.由半衰期 th 求平均寿命 τ。: Mean life tau from the half-life th.
map.衰变指数分布的特征时间。: The characteristic time of exponential decay.
map.用于存活概率 e^(−t/τ)。: Used for the survival probability e^(-t/tau).
map.：τ = 5730 / 0.693147 ≈ 8267 年；此时存活概率 e^(: : tau = 5730 / 0.693147, about 8267 years; the survival probability e^(-1) at that point is about 36.8% (see survival-probability).
map.：任意时刻存活核平均还能存在 τ 时间，是衰变常数的倒数（τ=1/λ）。: : at any moment the surviving nuclei last another tau on average, which is the reciprocal of the decay constant (tau = 1/lambda).
map.τ=1/λ=th/ln2，三者等价描述衰变快慢。: tau = 1/lambda = th/ln2; the three describe decay speed equivalently.
map.平均寿命能直接测吗？: Can mean life be measured directly?
map.由 th 或 λ 推算，本身为统计均值而非单个核的确切寿命。: Derived from th or lambda; itself a statistical mean rather than the exact lifetime of any single nucleus.
